articulation_estimation.description: Joint estimation from two-state observations of procedural two-part articulated objects (26 held-out scenes, 4 of the 13 object families unseen in train). Paper metrics and paper success rule (Sec. 4.2): axis error < 5 deg; revolute: pivot line distance < 0.05 and rotation geodesic error < 10 deg; prismatic: translation error < 0.05.
articulation_estimation.notes: Scaled-down substitute for PARIS-PMS / SPLART-PMS (Tables 1 and 4): procedural objects, 20 posed 48x48 RGB views and one sparse visible-surface point cloud per state, one run per scene. Per-scene errors are truncated at the success thresholds and averaged over all scenes (the paper averages over successful runs only), so a failed scene counts as the threshold value. The paper's own numbers are kept under _paper_reported.

success_rate.description: Fraction of scenes whose estimated articulation meets the paper's success criteria.

axis_error_deg.description: Angle between predicted and true joint axis (sign-invariant), degrees, truncated at 5, mean over all scenes.

pivot_error.description: Closest distance between predicted and true rotation axis lines, truncated at 0.05, mean over revolute scenes.

rotation_error_deg.description: Geodesic distance between predicted and true rotations of the motion, degrees, truncated at 10, mean over revolute scenes.

translation_error.description: Distance between predicted and true translation vectors of the motion, truncated at 0.05, mean over prismatic scenes.

part_reconstruction.description: Part-level reconstruction of the same 26 held-out scenes: the predicted static and mobile Gaussians are rendered at 8 held-out cameras per scene at articulation fractions q in [-0.1, 1.1] (novel views and novel articulations, as in SPLART-PMS) and compared with ground truth; part geometry is compared with dense ground-truth surfaces.
part_reconstruction.notes: Scaled-down substitute for Tables 1 (CD_s, CD_m, CD_w), 2 and 5 (PSNR, depth MAE, mIoU). Chamfer uses Gaussian centres with opacity >= 0.1 instead of TSDF meshes. Scenes whose articulation fails count with the worst value (the paper averages over successful runs only).

psnr.description: PSNR (dB) of held-out renders at novel views and articulation states; floored at 10, 10 for failed scenes.

part_miou.description: Mean IoU of background / static / mobile segmentation of the held-out renders.

depth_mae.description: Mean absolute error of composited depth over object pixels of the held-out views (per-pixel error capped at 1).

cd_static.description: Symmetric Chamfer distance (mean nearest-neighbour distance, both directions) between the static part and the true static surface; capped at 0.2.

cd_mobile.description: Same for the mobile part in the state-0 pose; capped at 0.2.

cd_whole.description: Same for the whole object in the state-0 pose; capped at 0.2.

_paper_reported.note: Numbers reported in the paper (arXiv 2506.03594) on PARIS-PMS and SPLART-PMS with full-resolution 3DGS and 10 seeds per scene. Not on this benchmark's scale (different objects, image resolution, units of Chamfer); kept for context only and never compared against gym scores.
